In summary, our research is concerned with

the determination of 238U/234U and 238U/236U isotope ratios of natural and synthetic uranium samples by thermal ionization mass spectrometry (TIMs) using the IRMS 3636 double spike as an isotopic tracer.
the development and implementation of a new generation of uranium isotopic reference materials for U–Th dating, U isotopic tracers, and U isotope geochemistry.
the development of new methods for the analysis of U isotopes, in particular 234U/238U and 238U/234U ratios.
